requirements.title: COMMON aligns the specified named and blank storage views
requirements.definition: Within one program, nonzero blocks with the same name share their first storage unit, while zero-sized blocks with that name associate with one another. Nonzero blank blocks share their first unit; zero-sized blank blocks associate mutually and with that first nonzero blank unit. Subsequent unit alignment, definition status and valid observations retain 19.5.3 and19.6; this is not an address-identity claim.

pending.named-two-scope-values: PENDING complete driver and two saved declaring external procedures with the same two-unit INTEGER named block but different member names. Seed and set writer members to11,22, check the reader's two literal values, then have the reader redefine its second member to33. A subsequent call to the first procedure uses a separate verify-only mode that does not reseed or rewrite the block, and must observe33. No COMMON member is simultaneously passed as an aliased dummy argument.
pending.blank-matching-prefix-values: PENDING complete writer with a three-unit default-INTEGER blank block and reader with a two-unit INTEGER blank block. Seed all three, set11,22,33 and independently check the reader's prefix 11,22; a later verify-only mode in the writer observes the third value33 without reseeding or rewriting the block. Keep the reader inside its declared bounds and the exact19.5.3.4p5 matching-prefix rule.
pending.same-scope-access-to-associated-views: PENDING one complete provider module declares INTEGER module_view(2) in a named block; an ordinary client USEs only module_view and independently declares different local INTEGER names in the same named block. Match/save all declarations, define through one view and check literal values through the other. The USE-associated object itself is not relisted in COMMON. Actual source roles must precede any relation to canonical USE/host owners.
pending.zero-sized-named-admission: PENDING complete program scopes each declare a zero-sized INTEGER array as the only member of the same named block. Source-review the zero-sized association and equal-size condition; compile admission is positive-control evidence only. No element access, pointer address or empty successful run proves the association.
pending.zero-sized-blank-admission: PENDING complete scopes with zero-sized blank blocks, preserving their actual empty sequences and local declarations. This is a compile/positive-control and source-relation plan, not a payload effect or a claim that absent COMMON declarations create storage.
pending.zero-and-nonzero-blank-boundary: PENDING a complete zero-sized blank view and another complete nonzero default-INTEGER blank view. The former has no readable element and is not falsely enlarged by the latter. Review the p1 first-unit relation and19.5.3.3p2 independently; no mixed-size named control, undefined reference or same-processor address query is allowed.

requirements.oracle: Actual defined-value propagation for nonzero compatible views, separately classified source/admission evidence for zero-sized cases. Every future effect requires a complete driver and all declaring/defining procedures, actual successful compile/link/run traces in the required f2023 configuration, independent literal observations and executed-call/completion checks. For named COMMON initial families, put consistent SAVE /block/ in every nonexempt declaring procedure and match the complete storage sequences; avoid relying on an accidentally active scope or implicit SAVE. Seed every observed storage unit with a known sentinel before the operation under test, so omitted-write sensitivity never reads undefined data. Keep actual arguments distinct from COMMON storage to avoid dummy-aliasing violations. Wrong-order/value/omission/omitted-call mutations must fail the whole counted parent, not a detached expression. No such program or mutation has been implemented here.
requirements.oracle_limitation: A zero-sized sequence cannot supply an element-value or physical first-address oracle. The zero admission facets retain positive-control roles and no storage-association effect credit. Cross-type and unsaved named-common undefinition are not observed by reading invalid values. All proposed evidence remains PENDING. No case, direct/linked facet, SourceUse relationship, inventory renewal, source approval, baseline change or universal conformance credit is created. Each reference/target/configuration is separate; f2018 success cannot corroborate an f2023 expectation. Numerical-kind, real/BOZ/IEEE, coarray and companion/CFI-header gates remain with their actual owners. Missing or unsupported prerequisite evidence cannot be treated as success.

requirements.title: Numeric-group COMMON association stays within the nonpointer group
requirements.definition: A nonpointer default INTEGER, default REAL, DOUBLE PRECISION REAL, default COMPLEX, default LOGICAL or numeric-sequence object can associate only with nonpointer objects of those listed types and kinds. This allows some different-type associations but does not prescribe mathematical conversion or defined cross-type payload values.

pending.same-type-group-admissions: PENDING complete matching two-scope declarations for each listed scalar group and a fully defined numeric SEQUENCE type. Preserve one-unit versus two-unit widths as language units under19.5.3.2, with constant bounds and no data references.
pending.different-type-numeric-admission: PENDING a complete one-unit INTEGER/REAL two-scope view pair and a separately matched two-unit default-COMPLEX versus two default-REAL objects. These are source-qualified compile positive controls only: integer/real reinterpretation, double/complex partial values and arbitrary bit patterns are not runtime oracles.
pending.outside-group-source-contrast: PENDING complete program declarations associate a default INTEGER object with a default CHARACTER object; repair the latter to the same default INTEGER type while retaining declarations. Document the separate storage-unit-sequence violation rather than requiring a uniquely attributed p2 error. Do not execute the negative.
pending.pointer-partner-source-contrast: PENDING a default-INTEGER nonpointer view versus a data-pointer view is nonconforming even if a processor's descriptor happens to fit. A complete same-type nonpointer repair removes POINTER and preserves a scalar declaration. Record p7 and unspecified-storage-unit overlaps; no general fatal predicate is supplied.
pending.numeric-kind-and-definedness-source: PENDING finite source relations to 7.5.2.3 and19.6.5(12)-(15)/19.6.6(1)/(9), including the special default-COMPLEX/default-REAL and total DOUBLE PRECISION conditions. Supported kind/model premises are configuration-specific; real/BOZ profile results elsewhere are neither copied nor silently weakened.

requirements.title: Character-group COMMON association stays within its nonpointer group
requirements.definition: A nonpointer default-CHARACTER or character-sequence object associates only with nonpointer objects in that character group. The rule does not require equal individual default-character lengths; total sequence, partial-association and definition conditions still apply.

pending.default-character-length-admission: PENDING complete same-sized named-block views CHARACTER(4) versus two CHARACTER(2) objects, without initializers or payload reads. All four character units are accounted; different individual lengths are not automatically invalid.

pending.kind-and-pointer-boundaries: PENDING complete conditional source/admission families distinguish default character from a genuinely supported nondefault character kind and from CHARACTER data pointers. The latter belongs to p7, not this nonpointer group. A missing nondefault kind is an unmet profile gate, not a passing boundary observation.

requirements.title: Other derived COMMON objects associate only with the same nonpointer type
requirements.definition: A nonpointer derived object outside the numeric- and character-sequence classes associates only with nonpointer objects of the same type. C8124 still requires SEQUENCE or BIND and no default initialization. Identical shapes, byte layouts or visible type-name spelling alone do not establish the type identity defined by7.5.2.4.

pending.mixed-sequence-same-definition: PENDING a complete shared module defines a public SEQUENCE type with an INTEGER and a CHARACTER(1) component, neither initialized. Both ordinary scopes USE only that type and declare their own whole COMMON objects of it. Same full type and storage sequence, not a coincidentally equal numeric unit count, admit it.
pending.separate-equivalent-definitions: PENDING complete separate SEQUENCE type definitions with the same type name, public components and identical component order/names/attributes, followed by matching COMMON objects. A one-component-name or type-name difference supplies a source contrast; repair only that difference and retain7.5.2.4 ownership.
pending.bind-derived-identity: PENDING complete views use one TYPE,BIND(C) definition with interoperable, nonpointer, nonallocatable components and no default initialization. Different BIND type names with visually similar components do not establish same Fortran type. No C struct-offset or descriptor comparison is proposed.
pending.nonpointer-and-eligibility-boundaries: PENDING source-led pointer-partner contrasts and SEQUENCE types with permitted pointer ultimate components keep the p7, C8123 and C8124 gates. Do not use a nonsequence ordinary type, private-definition shortcut or allocatable component violation as a supposedly isolated positive control.

requirements.title: A nonpointer enum COMMON object associates only with the same enum type
requirements.definition: A nonpointer object of an enum type associates only with nonpointer objects of that same enum type. The type is the named7.6.1 ENUM,BIND(C) type; its enumerators are integer constants, but its objects do not become integer objects.7.6.2 enumeration objects are separately excluded.

pending.same-enum-definition: PENDING a complete module defines ENUM,BIND(C)::shade with at least one valid enumerator; two complete declaring scopes USE the same type and have TYPE(shade) COMMON objects. Keep the actual f2023 type feature and companion-kind premises, no fallback.

One block view has the first type and the other the second; repair only the second object's declared type. Both complete definitions remain so unsupported type syntax cannot masquerade as cause.

The former is not the same enum type despite representation compatibility; the latter already violates C8123. Do not create one generic ENUM diagnostic predicate or infer values using TRANSFER.

This includes applicable CHARACTER length as well as kind; equal physical widths are irrelevant.

requirements.title: Storage-associated data pointers match their declared characteristics
requirements.definition: Storage-associated data pointers have the same type and rank, defer the same type parameters, and have equal corresponding nondeferred parameter values. Actual target values cannot repair mismatching declared patterns. The separate storage-unit rules also distinguish CONTIGUOUS.

pending.matching-scalar-and-array-pointers: PENDING complete separate program scopes declare matching scalar INTEGER pointers, or matching rank-one INTEGER pointers with deferred shape, as bare COMMON members. Use the same CONTIGUOUS presence/absence. Admission does not query their initially undefined association status or claim a descriptor layout.
pending.type-and-rank-contrasts: PENDING complete two-scope source matrices vary only one partner's intrinsic type, or scalar versus rank-one declaration; repair exactly that declaration. Retain any unspecified-unit mismatch as a source overlap, and do not substitute a procedure pointer.

requirements.title: Storage-associated TARGET objects match TARGET, type and parameters
requirements.definition: An object with TARGET can be storage associated only with another TARGET object of the same type and type parameters. p8 does not add rank equality. Nonpointer subobjects inherit TARGET under8.5.18p2, but EQUIVALENCE independently excludes TARGET via C8112.

pending.matching-target-admission: PENDING complete saved named COMMON declarations of INTEGER,TARGET objects in two ordinary scopes, with no EQUIVALENCE or pointer attributes. Matching source is a compile positive control.
pending.missing-target-source-contrast: PENDING remove TARGET only from one view of that complete program, then restore it for the control. Equal type and unit sequence do not waive the partner attribute condition.

review_rationale: Independent original-source review925b4227 and all36pending plans in doc/source_audits/batch_084.json. Zero/nonzero and named/blank association branches retain their exact conditions; three zero-payload facets are explicitly positive controls. Seven prose restrictions distinguish nonpointer numeric/default, character, other-derived, enum and remaining intrinsic groups, data-pointer type/rank/deferred-pattern/nondeferred values, and TARGET partners without adding pointer rank equality. Original19.5.3/19.6 storage-unit, CONTIGUOUS, matching-sequence, type-identity and definedness gates prevent byte-width, conversion or undefined-read assumptions. No universal fatal diagnostic or new runtime evidence.
